guarantees.claim: When asynchronous reset is active (rst_ni low), aes_wrap_ctrl_cs is driven to IDLE and count_q is set to 32'b0.
On the rising edge of clk_i with rst_ni high, aes_wrap_ctrl_cs is updated with aes_wrap_ctrl_ns and count_q with count_d.

assumptions.claim: aes_wrap_ctrl_ns and count_d must be stable and hold valid values at the positive edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high.
assumptions.cond: at every posedge clk_i with rst_ni deasserted
assumptions.risk: Invalid or glitchy inputs can corrupt the FSM state or counter, leading to incorrect AES operation or possible security bypass.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be glitch-free because its negative edge immediately resets the registers asynchronously.
assumptions.risk: A spurious low pulse can reset the AES FSM to IDLE and zero the counter mid-operation, potentially leaking intermediate data or disrupting a cryptographic sequence.
